title: Update style and textarea elements when their children are moved
body: The DOM Standard now has children moved steps, which run for both parents of a moved node. style and textarea elements now use them to update like they do for other changes to their children, as implementations do. script elements don't, so moving a child into a script element still doesn't run it, as tested by dom/nodes/moveBefore/script-move-before.html. This depends on https://github.com/whatwg/dom/pull/1515. - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * WebKit, Chromium, and Gecko already notify both parents of a move, and don't run a script element when a child is moved into it. * … - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * … (style and textarea) * [dom/nodes/moveBefore/script-move-before.html](https://wpt.fyi/results/dom/nodes/moveBefore/script-move-before.html) - [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: … * Gecko: … * WebKit: none needed * Deno (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, module resolution, web workers, and web storage): N/A * Node.js (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, and module resolution): N/A - [ ] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [ ] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
